# State Class View (variant): Environmental permit writer (local)

> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**
>
> All task importance, time share, critical, needed-at-entry and target-level values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S). They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Credential gates and sign-off are shown only as drafts until an E-labelled source is attached.

- **Role:** Environmental permit writer (`seed:R11-environmental-permit-writer`, P1); authority position (editorial): regulator
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.1.0, rule state-class-view@0.1.0 (proposed), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (agent draft)

- Draft enforceable, implementable binding instruments — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Issue environmental permits and resource-use authorizations as the deciding authority — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Map the decision authority and procedural pathway for a proposed action — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Build and maintain a defensible administrative record — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Negotiate permit conditions, mitigation and agreements using interest-based methods — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Track regulatory change and translate it into operating guidance — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Operate within, or oversee, delegated and assumed regulatory programs — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Process permit applications and administer issued authorizations — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
